description: This is a PHP test class file for the LeaveBalanceAPI, part of the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It contains test cases for various API endpoints related to leave balance management, including retrieving leave balances, handling partial days, holidays, weekends, and validating different scenarios for leave calculations.

classes.name: LeaveBalanceAPITest
classes.description: A PHPUnit test class for the LeaveBalanceAPI, testing various leave balance retrieval scenarios, including validation, partial days, holidays, weekends, and multiple days.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Initializes test data by populating fixtures before each test case runs.

methods.name: testDelete
methods.description: Tests that the delete method of the LeaveBalanceAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForDelete
methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForDelete method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testUpdate
methods.description: Tests that the update method of the LeaveBalanceAPI throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetValidationRuleForUpdate
methods.description: Tests that the getValidationRuleForUpdate method throws a not implemented exception.

methods.name: testGetLeaveApplicationService
methods.description: Verifies that the API correctly retrieves an instance of LeaveApplicationService.

methods.name: testGetOneOnlyWithLeaveTypeId
methods.description: Tests retrieval of leave balance for specific leave type IDs, for a given employee and date, including cases with non-entitlement and non-existent employees.

methods.name: getOneOnlyWithLeaveTypeIdDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various scenario data for testing leave balance retrieval by leave type ID for different employees and leave types.

methods.name: testGetOneSingleDay
methods.description: Tests leave balance and breakdown for a single day, covering full day, half day, specify time, holidays, weekends, and non-working days.

methods.name: getOneSingleDayDataProvider
methods.description: Provides various scenarios of single-day leave balances including holidays, weekends, partial days, and adjacent leave types.

methods.name: testGetOneMultiDay
methods.description: Tests leave balances over multiple days, with partial days, start/end partial, holidays, weekends, and negative balances.

methods.name: getOneMultiDayDataProvider
methods.description: Provides scenarios of multi-day leave balances, including partial days options and holiday/full day overlaps.
